SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
WEDNESDAY - APRIL 1, 2020 -
07:00 P.M.
TELECONFERENCE MEETING AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20
VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 198 543 361
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, the City Council Chamber and City Hall are closed to the public. Consistent with State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the Los Angeles County Health Officer’s “Safer at Home Order for Control of COVID-19” the City Council will participate in the meeting through teleconference. Public participation in the meeting will be facilitated through the electronic methods as described below.
Agenda Materials:
The agenda and agenda packet related to items on this agenda are available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet will be made available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION:
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us and on Cerritos TV3.
Public Comments:
Public comments are limited to the items listed on this Special Meeting agenda only. Members of the public may provide public comment through the following methods:
Email: Members of the public may provide public comment by submitting an email to city_clerk@cerritos.us by 5:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the meeting date and agenda item number for which you would like to provide comment in the subject line of the email. The public comment will be distributed to all members of the City Council. During the meeting your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference participation: You may provide audio public comment by connecting to the teleconference meeting online or by telephone/mobile call (please select only one method). Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time on the agenda. You must be available to provide comment at the time your connection is “unmuted.” If you are not planning on providing public comment we encourage you to observe the meeting via livestream or on Cerritos TV3 to allow staff to more effectively manage the number of teleconference connections.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us04web.zoom.us/j/198543361
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: 669-900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 198 543 361
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accommodations:
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer at 562-916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 1, 2020, 7:00 P.M., TELECONFERENCE MEETING
AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND
N-29-20, VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 198 543 361

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The pledge of allegiance was led by Mayor Solanki.

3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

4.  Public Comments
  This section is reserved for comments related to items listed on this Special Meeting
  agenda only.

  Anantha Naranayan spoke regarding the COVID-19 local emergency and the
  enforcement of social distancing at community parks.

  Murali Vasudevan offered congratulations to all City Councilmembers for their service.

  Tobi Balma spoke regarding the COVID-19 local emergency and expressed concerns
  with any potential closure of community parks.

  Sam Desai offered congratulations to newly elected City Councilmembers and spoke
  regarding the impact of the COVID-19 local emergency on the community.

5.  Recognition of outgoing Councilmembers and Mayor

  Sanjay Khetani congratulated Mayor Solanki.

  Henry Lowe offered congratulations to outgoing Councilmember Pulido.

  Willie offered congratulations to outgoing Councilmember Pulido.

  Melissa Ramoso offered congratulations to outgoing Councilmember Pulido newly
  elected City Councilmembers.

  Rene Trevino offered congratulations to outgoing Councilmember Pulido and newly
  elected City Councilmembers.

  Hannah Cho offered congratulations on behalf of Los Angeles City Council Member
  Herb Wesson outgoing Councilmember Pulido.
 City of Cerritos  April 1, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 4

5.  Recognition of outgoing Councilmembers and Mayor (continued)

  John Darnell offered congratulations to outgoing Councilmember Pulido and thanked
  him for his continued support of the City’s programs, in particular the City’s Tot Lot
  program.

  Ernie Nishii, ABC Unified School Board member, congratulated Councilmember Pulido
  for his years of service on the City Council and community.

  Rocky Pavone offered congratulations to outgoing Councilmember Pulido and thanked
  him for his years of service and congratulated the newly elected City
  Councilmembers.

  Letty Mendoza offered congratulations to outgoing Councilmember Pulido and
  thanked him for his years of service on both the City Council and ABC Unified School
  Board. She also congratulated the newly elected City Councilmembers.

  Mayor Solanki recognized the accomplishments of Councilmember Pulido and thanked
  him for his years of service to the community.

  Councilmember Pulido made comments related to his years of service on the Cerritos
  City Council.

6.  Installation of Officers

6A.  City Clerk administers Oath of Office to newly elected City
  Councilmembers

  City Clerk/Treasurer Vida Barone administered the Oath of Office to newly elected
  Council/Agency members Jim Edwards, Naresh Solanki and Chuong Vo.

7.  Meeting recess

  The meeting recess took place prior to the installation of officers (Item 6).

8.  Roll Call of Newly Installed City Council

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance via
  teleconference:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Chuong Vo
  Council/Agency Member Frank Yokoyama

9.  Annual Mayoral Transition

9A.  Selection of Mayor/Agency Chair

  City Clerk/Treasurer Vida Barone declared the office of Mayor/Chair vacant and called
  for nominations for the office of Mayor/Chair.
 City of Cerritos  April 1, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 4

9.  Annual Mayoral Transition (continued)

9A.  (continued)

  Council/Agency Member Edwards nominated Council/Agency Member Solanki for the
  office of Mayor/Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Hu nominated Council/Agency Member Yokoyama for the
  office of Mayor/Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, the City Clerk/Treasurer declared
  nominations closed.

  MOTION: The Council/Agency Member announced their votes for the Council/Agency
  Members nominated for the office of Mayor/Chair as follows:

  In favor of Council/Agency Member Solanki:  Edwards, Solanki, Vo
  In favor of Council/Agency Member Yokoyama:  Hu, Yokoyama

  City Clerk/Treasurer Vida Barone declared Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  elected to the office of Mayor/Chair by acclamation.

9B.  Selection of Mayor Pro Tempore/Agency Vice Chair

  Council/Agency Member Solanki nominated Council/Agency Member Vo for the office
  of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Hu nominated Council/Agency Member Yokoyama for the
  office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Yokoyama declined the nomination for the office of Mayor Pro
  Tem/Vice Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Hu nominated Council/Agency member Edwards
  for the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, City Clerk/Treasurer Vida Barone declared
  nominations closed.

  MOTION: The Council/Agency Member announced their votes for the Council/Agency
  Members nominated for the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair as follows:

  In favor of Council/Agency Member Vo:  Edwards, Solanki, Vo, Yokoyama
  In favor of Council/Agency Member Edwards:  Hu

  City Clerk/Treasurer Vida Barone declared Council/Agency Member Chuong Vo elected
  to the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair by acclamation.

  Mayor/Chair Solanki and Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Vo made brief comments.
 City of Cerritos  April 1, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 4

10.  New Business

10A.  Review and consideration of an informational update on the City’s response to the
  COVID-19 local emergency (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City & Theater Marketing Manager/City
  Librarian. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The public was provided an opportunity to provide comment on all special meeting
  agenda items (Agenda Item 4) in accordance with the provisions of the California
  Brown Act.

  There was no further action taken on this item.

11.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:45 p.m.

  /s/Vida Barone
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary
